notes.title: Version V1.1.5 Update-the cloud save functionality will be restored
notes.notes:
Version V1.1.5 Update:
Dear generals,

Cloud saving has been re-enabled. To activate the cloud save feature, simply update to version V1.1.5. Some players may encounter issues where their save files are not being uploaded to the cloud. In such cases, you can manually override and upload your saves.

(1) Step 1: Locate the save folder: C:\Users<Your User>\AppData\LocalLow\zjy, and open the 'back' folder. (Note: Some computers may have AppData hidden. You can unhide it by going to the 'View' menu in the file menu bar and checking 'Hidden items.')

(2) Step 2: Select a recent save folder within the 'back' folder and open it. Choose a save from before the V1.1.5 cloud save update, for example, a version from before March 1st.

(3) Step 3: Copy all files in the save folder for later use, including: Version, allVersion, allVersion_temp/Player, Player-prev, etc.

(4) Step 4: Return to the LocalLow\zjy folder, open 'zygame_steam,' and paste the files copied in Step 3 to overwrite the original files.

(5) Step 5: Restart the game. Your manual saves will appear in the list. Old saves will lack thumbnails and appear white. You can enter them by clicking, then manually save to overwrite the old saves and update the thumbnails (optional operation for those who find the blank thumbnails uncomfortable).

notes.title: Upcoming Release-Jan 18th-Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun
notes.notes:
Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun will be officially released on 0:00 AM January 18th 2024 PST, priced at $19.99. Launch discount: 10% OFF

The Contents of Official Version:

- Dive into 12 complete story chapters and follow the growth process of Zhao Yun, a famed general of the Three Kingdoms era.
- Choose from 3 difficulty levels, with a minimum of 30 hours experience of main storyline.
- Master 4 distinct weapon systems: spears, bows and arrows, swords, and steeds, supplemented by equipment systems like crafting, sets, refinement, and enchantment.
- Explore no fewer than 30 expansive maps.
- Encounter dozens of well-known Chinese historical figures, who will either fight by your side or become your adversaries.
- Enjoy a wide range of visually striking outfits for the protagonist and companions.
- Engage in several large-scale, renowned battles that truly capture the essence of the Three Kingdoms atmosphere.

notes.title: Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun-Delayed release until January
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are the publisher of the Legend of Zhao Yun: Yunhan Teng Dragon. The game was originally scheduled to be released on December 7th, but we found some problems that affected the normal experience of the game during several internal tests. After repeated communication with the development team, in order to ensure the quality of the game, we decided to postpone the release of the game to mid-to-late January.

Currently, we have found the following issues in our internal testing of the full version:
(1) The new screen detail elements cause some scenes to stall, which requires high configuration requirements and takes time to adapt and optimize the performance
(2) Sword skill system, special effects, etc. have been developed, but it takes time to polish to the state of launch
(3) There is a large amount of plot, and there are some problems in the detail optimization of dubbing and lines in the story line

The above problems may affect everyone's game experience to a certain extent, our comprehensive evaluation, the current version has not reached the best state of sale, comprehensive decision to postpone the launch. At present, we have determined the solution, and we want to gain time to polish the content details and experience. We hope you can give us some more time.
